error.generic: The operation could not be completed. Your original file has not been intentionally overwritten; check available backups if a save was interrupted.
error.api.unavailable: The local editor service is unavailable. Restart the application.
error.file.too_large: This file exceeds the supported size limit.
error.file.unsupported_type: Choose a PUD map or a W2TR trigger file.
error.file.wrong_extension: Keep the original file type when saving. Renaming the extension does not convert a PUD map into W2TR or vice versa.
error.pud.invalid_type: This file does not have a valid Warcraft II map header.
error.pud.truncated_header: A map section header is incomplete.
error.pud.truncated_section: A map section extends beyond the end of the file.
error.pud.invalid_length: A map section has an invalid length.
error.pud.missing_oilm: This map has no OILM section for trigger data.
error.pud.duplicate_oilm: Multiple OILM sections were found. Export is disabled to protect the map.
error.pud.capacity_exceeded: The trigger program does not fit in this map’s OILM section.
error.pud.opaque_tail: Adding commands would replace unrecognized data after the original program. This change is blocked to preserve the map.
error.w2tr.invalid_boundary: The trigger program boundary could not be confirmed.
error.w2tr.invalid_terminator: The trigger program has an invalid end marker.
error.w2tr.unknown_metadata: The file contains unknown editor metadata. It is preserved; editing is disabled.
error.w2tr.truncated_name: A variable name record is incomplete. The original bytes are preserved.
error.w2tr.opaque_metadata_readonly: Editing is disabled because the metadata format is not fully understood.
error.trigger.unknown_subcommand: An unsupported units-list operation was found.
error.trigger.unknown_opcode: An unsupported command was found. Its remaining bytes are preserved.
error.trigger.invalid_terminator: The trigger program has an invalid end marker.
error.trigger.missing_terminator: The trigger program has no confirmed end marker.
error.trigger.invalid_command_length: A command has the wrong number of argument bytes.
error.trigger.argument_range: An argument is outside its permitted range.
error.trigger.field_count: The supplied fields do not match this command.
error.trigger.unmatched_if_end: An end IF command has no matching condition.
error.trigger.unclosed_if: A condition has no matching end IF command.
error.trigger.unmatched_repeat_end: An end Repeat command has no matching Repeat.
error.trigger.unclosed_repeat: A Repeat block is not closed.
error.trigger.text_too_long: The text exceeds the game’s byte limit for this command.
error.trigger.unrepresentable_text: Some characters cannot be encoded in the supported game text encoding.
error.trigger.invalid_index: This command no longer exists. Refresh the document.
error.trigger.invalid_operation: This action is not available at this position.
error.document.readonly: This file is open for viewing only.
error.document.revision_conflict: The document has changed. Refresh it before applying this edit.
error.document.empty_history: There are no more changes to undo or redo.
error.document.unapplied_fields: Review and apply the changes in the properties panel before saving.
error.document.not_found: The document session is no longer available.
error.storage.io: A file operation failed. Check access permissions and free space.
error.storage.external_change: The file was changed by another program. Saving has been stopped.
error.storage.backup_verification: The backup could not be verified. Saving has been stopped.
error.storage.write_verification: The temporary output could not be verified. Saving has been stopped.
error.storage.final_verification: The final file could not be verified. Recover the original from its backup.
error.recovery.invalid_snapshot: The recovery snapshot is damaged or uses an unsupported version.
error.recovery.invalid_id: The recovery snapshot identifier is invalid.
error.recovery.already_open: This recovery snapshot is already open.
error.auth.denied: The local session could not be authenticated. Restart the application.
